Interviewer: Dr. Anthony Brown with engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 76 pp.

Today is the 7th of December 2011 and this is the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History interview with NEA Jazz Master, pianist, composer, arranger, bandleader, and humanitarian, McCoy Tyner at the Blue Note club in New York City. Good afternoon Mr. McCoy Tyner.

And I also want to acknowledge that his wife, Aisha is present and this interview is being conducted by Anthony Brown, with Ken Kimery. So, if we could start from the beginning, if you could tell us your given birth name, birthplace, and birthdate please.
